brief.goal: Optimize onboarding so user completes setup in under 15 minutes with Docker compose one-command start, guided onboarding wizard, time tracking, and clear error recovery at each step.
constraints: Existing telemetry event system (no time tracking yet)
Zod validation on all IPC payloads
nonGoals: Do NOT change the Docker compose service definition (n8n config is stable)
Do NOT add new third-party dependencies for the wizard UI
Do NOT modify the existing telemetry consent flow (extend, don't replace)
Do NOT implement email/task connectors (separate issues)
successCriteria: User can start the full stack with a single command (docker compose up + electron app launch)
Guided onboarding wizard walks user through: Docker check → n8n health → API key setup → first account connection
Setup duration is tracked from first launch to first triaged email
Each onboarding step has clear error messages and recovery actions
Total setup time target: under 15 minutes for a new user

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the setup optimization goal below. Include requirements, constraints, and measurable success criteria. Follow the spec pattern from specs/001-electron-shell-sqlite/spec.md.
Break down the specification into an implementation plan with ordered, verifiable tasks. Include source reference analysis of existing code.
Generate the detailed task list from the plan — each task must have exact file paths and verification steps.
Implement the next pending task from the plan. Follow test-driven practices.
Review the implementation against the specification and success criteria. Verify independently — you are the checker, not the maker.
